set system host-name PE2.explanation: Configure the hostname of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The hostname of the device, used to identify the device in the network.

set routing-options router-id 192.168.3..explanation: Configure the router ID used by routing protocols.

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: The router ID, typically an IPv4 address, used to identify the router in routing protocols.

set protocols ldp.explanation: Enable the Label Distribution Protocol (LDP) for MPLS.

set protocols ldp interface lo0.0.explanation: Configure LDP to use the specified interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The interface name for LDP to use.

set interfaces se-2/0/1 encapsulation pp.explanation: Configure the encapsulation type for the serial interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The serial interface name.

parameters.name: encapsulation
parameters.explanation: The encapsulation type, such as PPP.

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.2.2.2/24
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure the IPv4 address and subnet mask of the interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface names, such as ge-2/0/0.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The interface unit number is used to distinguish multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: The number of bits of the IPv4 subnet mask.

set protocols mpls interface ge-2/0/0.0.explanation: Enable MPLS on the specified interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The interface name for MPLS to use.

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: Configure the IPv4 address and subnet mask of the loopback interface.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The loopback interface name.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The interface unit number is used to distinguish multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the loopback interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: The number of bits of the IPv4 subnet mask.

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.template: set protocols ospf area [parameter1] interface [parameter2] passive

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: Configure OSPF to include the specified interface in the specified area as a passive interface.

parameters.name: area
parameters.explanation: The OSPF area identifier.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The interface name to be included in the OSPF area as passive.
